lines.text: In Thessalonica, Paul reasoned from the Scriptures in the synagogue on three Sabbaths, proving the Christ had to suffer and rise.
Some Jews joined Paul and Silas, along with many God-fearing Romans and quite a few leading women.
Jealous Jews formed a mob and raided Jason's house, then dragged Jason before the city officials, who collected bond and released him.
Paul and Silas went to the synagogue in Berea, where the Bereans examined the Scriptures every day, and many believed.
Jews from Thessalonica stirred up the crowds in Berea, so Paul was escorted to Corinth while Silas and Timothy remained.
